sn35.141:1.2: The cause and condition for the arising of the eye is also suffering.
sn35.141:1.3: As the eye has originated from what is suffering, how could it be happiness?
sn35.141:1.8: The cause and condition for the arising of the mind is also suffering.
sn35.141:1.9: As the mind has originated from what is suffering, how could it be happiness?
sn35.141:1.11: He understands: ‘… there is no more for this state of being.’”
